reference: C061: saved74-input support-guard q2 depth4 shared-quantile balanced25 raw-direct-parent AJ10; seeds17/155/8679,32trees each, equally averaged. Zero XAI fits and no pointer replacement.
data: Exact archived Jan1 2023/2024/2025 training snapshots, original next-trading-day pre-open entry features,24calendar-month training cap; 74 columns in unchanged order. Same evaluation companies, first final delisting cause1 vs first recovery cause2. 2025H24 predictions only, performance NA. No new original-source data.
model: Independent binary:logistic gbtree XGBoost for each cutoff/horizon, first delisting by H positive; competing recovery before H negative, event-free through H negative, early censoring unknown. This is an IPCW fixed-horizon classifier, not a joint two-cause survival curve. No recovery classifier in this finite addition.
preprocessing: Original74 dense numeric columns, NaN retained for native learned default missing direction; no imputation, extra missing columns, scaling, feature selection, oversampling or class reweighting. Fail on infinity.
weighting: Reuse ESWA Horizon IPCW: censoring reverse KM estimated solely in each historical fitting partition, G(event-) or G(H-); unknown labels excluded from loss, never coded negative. No weight normalization, probability clipping or G floor. Stop at positivity violation. Validation metrics use the repository evaluation_context cohort-IPCW definition on historical validation only.
forward_folds: For outer cutoffY and horizonH, validation entry cohorts Y-3,Y-2. Inner fit uses outer historical companies entering before Jan1 of validation year, observed stop recensored strictly before that inner Jan1; never use later events to train that fold. Validation labels only as observed in outer cutoff snapshot. Unknown validation endpoints weighted0. Score a fold for AP only if known positive and negative are present; retain all fold support records. Same folds/candidates/seeds for all configurations.
selection: For each of18candidates, average three seed validation probabilities before scoring. Maximize equal-cohort mean IPCW AP among valid AP folds; ties within1e-12 prefer lower equal-cohort IPCW Brier, then fewer rounds, shallower depth, larger lambda. If no AP-valid fold select lowest supported historical Brier with same complexity tie-break. If no fitting/metric-valid fold use prespecified depth2/96rounds/lambda10 and record fallback. Folds with single-class fitting labels not fitted. No early stopping or extension of grid, no selection on outer outcomes.
budget: Six independent cutoff/horizon tasks. At most18candidates x2forwardfolds x3seeds x6tasks=648historical tuning fits plus18finalXGBoost fits. Zero new XAI fits. Synthetic numerical tests separately counted, no extra real-data pilot fits; first formal task output counts in batch. XGBoost rounds are not RSF tree-budget equivalents.
evaluation: Primary12month delisting, secondary24months. Average final three seed probabilities before metrics; separately retain each seed. Annual/pooled AUC,within-year-pair weighted AUC,AP,IPCW Brier,mean forecast,observed,calibration gap,O/E,Top20 captured/coverage. Annual quota ceil(.2n),ties sample_id; pooled Top20 sums annual selections. Recompute pooled metrics, never average yearly AP. Assert supported evaluation weights=1 before reusing fixed-prediction assessment.
uncertainty: Original1000 company draws, year-stratified, seed2026110201; all models share exact stored indices. Percentile95% paired XGBoost-minus-C061 differences; report undefined draws.
